headline.zh: 首个公开测试版今天发布
headline.en: The first public test build is out today

summary.zh: 量盘、作画、刻录一条路走通；彩色图可以直接刻，手机拍照校准已经用真手机测通。Windows 和 Linux 都有免安装包。
summary.en: Measure, draw and burn in one path; a colour picture can go straight onto a disc, and photo calibration with a phone has been tried on a real phone. Portable packages for Windows and Linux.

title.en: A colour picture, straight onto a disc

story.zh: 本报讯　导入一张彩色图，选好手机型号和拍摄高度，程序逐格挑纹理，先给预测图看，点头才出镜像。新作品默认在 12 点放一个方向箭头，拍照时对准纸上的箭头。实盘通常没有预测图鲜艳。
story.en: Our correspondent reports: import a colour picture, choose your phone and shooting height, and the program picks a texture for each cell, shows a predicted image first, and makes the ISO only when you agree. New works get a direction arrow at 12 o'clock to line up with the sheet. Real discs usually look less vivid than the preview.

title.zh: 手机拍照校准，真手机测通
title.en: Photo calibration with a phone, tried on a real one

story.zh: 本报讯　扫码就能用手机拍照直传电脑。打开闪光灯（设成“开”），背对吸顶灯，盘朝自己转 20–30°。读不出时可以手动套圈、认箭头。检查盘要刻完接着拍，隔开补拍的用不上。
story.en: Scan the code and the phone sends its photos straight to the computer. Flash on (set to On), back to the ceiling light, disc turned 20–30° towards you. If reading fails, fit the circle and point out the arrow by hand. Photograph a check disc right after burning it; photos taken later are not used.

title.zh: 盘库能删能找回，Linux 一键启动
title.en: A library you can tidy, and one-click start on Linux

story.zh: 本报讯　批次和作品可以删，先进回收站，还能找回来。Linux 也有了一键启动的免安装包，自带 Python；Linux 上读盘刻盘还没在真光驱上测过，欢迎来信。
story.en: Batches and works can be deleted; they go to a recycle bin first and can be restored. Linux gets a portable package with its own Python and a one-click start; reading and burning on Linux are not yet tried on a real drive, and letters are welcome.

title.en: Editor: colour gets its own page

story.zh: 本报讯　影调和颜色分成两页。选好手机和拍摄高度后，色板铺满整栏，当前颜色和“填充”按钮一直停在顶上，翻到哪里都能点。左边的长说明收进了“说明”里，要看再点开。
story.en: Our correspondent reports: tone and colour now sit on two pages. Once the phone and height are chosen, the swatches fill the column, and the current colour and the Fill button stay at the top however far you scroll. The long notes on the left fold away under About.

title.zh: 选盘时，社区测过的会提一句
title.en: Choosing a disc: a word if the community measured it

story.zh: 本报讯　这批盘要是有人在 DIS 社区测过，选盘那一步会提示来源和测量范围。这只是提示：不是 DP 测的，这批盘还要自己确认。
story.en: If someone in the DIS community has measured this batch, the disc step says so, with the source and the measured range. It is a hint only: not measured by DP, and your batch still needs confirming.

title.zh: 一张盘，图和文件一起刻
title.en: One disc, a picture and files together

story.zh: 本报讯　DVD 上画图用不到的地方，现在可以放文件，任何电脑都能直接读。可擦写盘也能先擦掉再重刻；刻到一半想停，要滑动确认，倒数三秒才放行。
story.en: On a DVD, the space the picture does not use can now hold files that any computer reads. A rewritable disc can be erased and burned again, and stopping a burn halfway takes a slide and a three-second countdown.

pitch.zh: 全新上市！把整张桌子换成牛皮纸色，铜色按钮更亮一点。耐看、耐脏、不伤眼。
pitch.en: New! The whole desk in kraft brown, the copper buttons a shade brighter. Easy on the eyes, hides the coffee rings.

pitch.zh: 熬夜刻盘的你值得拥有！深蓝底、白线条，像一张工程图。附赠：不晃眼的琥珀色。
pitch.en: For the late-night burner! Deep blue, white lines, like an engineering drawing. Bonus: an amber that won't glare.

note.zh: 极坐标排布，越往外越疏
最省事的背景，刻错也看得出来
note.en: The simplest background; a wrong preset shows at once

caption.zh: 一张 DVD-R 上刻图又存了 1.38 GB 数据，读回来没有错。颜色随角度变。
caption.en: A picture plus 1.38 GB of data on one DVD-R, read back without an error. The colour changes with the angle.
The whole scroll in two rings.

caption.zh: 先用 geo，再在 DiscImageStudio 里精修。经作者同意刊登。
caption.en: geo first, then fine calibration in DiscImageStudio. Printed with the author's permission.

jokes.zh: 问：光盘为什么从不迷路？答：它一直沿着轨道走。
jokes.en: Why does a disc never get lost? It always stays on track.

jokes.zh: 我的光驱很有礼貌：每次弹出来都先打个招呼——咔哒。
jokes.en: My drive is very polite: every time it pops out, it says click first.

jokes.zh: CD 问 DVD：你怎么装下那么多东西？DVD：轨距收紧一点就好。
jokes.en: CD asked DVD how it holds so much. DVD: just tighten your track pitch.

jokes.zh: 这台传真机只收不发。它说：我是个好听众。
jokes.en: This fax only receives. It says it is a good listener.

jokes.zh: 刻坏的盘也有用：可以当杯垫，还能顺便看彩虹。
jokes.en: A failed burn still has uses: a coaster with a rainbow.

title.en: Colour that holds in your hand

note.zh: 色板换成新纹理库，优先选斜一点也不变色的纹理。
note.en: The palette moves to the new texture library, preferring textures that keep their colour when tilted.

note.zh: 包裹拆开就能换上，不喜欢再换回来。
note.en: Open the parcel and wear it; switch back if you don't like it.

note.zh: 还是这张桌子，只是能转一转。
note.en: The same desk, only you can turn it.
